# Verify Lanka

> Verify Lanka is a Sri Lankan mystery shopping and customer experience audit company. Independent auditors visit businesses as real customers, in person and by phone, and deliver scored reports within 48 hours. We cover the whole island, every district, city, town and remote area.

Website: https://verifylanka.com/
Contact: info@verifylanka.com
Service area: all of Sri Lanka

## Services

- [Mystery Shopping in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/mystery-shopping-sri-lanka/): Independent mystery shopping across all of Sri Lanka. Trained auditors visit your outlets as real customers and report exactly what happened, within 48 hours.
- [Customer Service Audit in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/customer-service-audit-sri-lanka/): A customer service audit shows how your staff really treat customers in person, by phone and online. Independent, island wide, with a clear scored report.
- [Branch Audit in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/branch-audit-sri-lanka/): Branch experience audits across every district of Sri Lanka. See which branches deliver your standard and which do not, with scored reports in 48 hours.
- [Compliance Checks in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/compliance-checks-sri-lanka/): Independent compliance checks at your outlets across Sri Lanka. We test whether staff follow your policies, scripts and legal disclosure rules in real customer situations.
- [Monthly Retainer Audits in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/monthly-retainer-audits-sri-lanka/): Ongoing monthly mystery shopping and customer experience tracking across Sri Lanka. See your scores move month by month and know whether training is working.

## Industries we audit

- [Bank Branch Audit in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/bank-branch-audit-sri-lanka/): Independent bank branch audits and mystery shopping across Sri Lanka. Test teller service, product knowledge, queues and digital help at every branch.
- [Finance Company and Leasing Audits in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/finance-company-audit-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for finance companies and leasing firms across Sri Lanka. Check loan enquiry handling, rate disclosure and branch service at every outlet.
- [Insurance Mystery Shopping in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/insurance-mystery-shopping-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for insurance companies and agents in Sri Lanka. Check policy explanations, claim support and branch service across the island.
- [Telecom Mystery Shopping in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/telecom-mystery-shopping-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for mobile, broadband and fibre providers in Sri Lanka. Check retail outlets, dealers, hotlines and complaint handling island wide.
- [Hotel and Resort Mystery Shopping in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/hotel-mystery-shopping-sri-lanka/): Independent hotel mystery shopping across Sri Lanka. Mystery stays, reception, rooms, dining and complaint handling, scored and reported within 48 hours.
- [Restaurant and Cafe Mystery Shopping in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/restaurant-mystery-shopping-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for restaurants, cafes and food chains in Sri Lanka. Check service speed, food quality, hygiene and order accuracy at every outlet.
- [Supermarket and Retail Store Audits in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/supermarket-retail-audit-sri-lanka/): Retail audits and mystery shopping for supermarkets and store chains in Sri Lanka. Check shelf availability, price accuracy, billing and staff help.
- [Fuel Station Audits in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/fuel-station-audit-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping and audits for fuel stations and forecourts in Sri Lanka. Check attendant service, cleanliness, safety, receipts and convenience stores.
- [Hospital and Clinic Patient Experience Audits in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/hospital-clinic-audit-sri-lanka/): Patient experience audits for private hospitals, clinics and labs in Sri Lanka. Check reception, waiting times, billing clarity, privacy and cleanliness.
- [Pharmacy Mystery Shopping in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/pharmacy-mystery-shopping-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for pharmacy chains in Sri Lanka. Check advice quality, prescription handling, price clarity and customer privacy across your outlets.
- [Airline and Travel Agency Mystery Shopping in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/airline-travel-agency-audit-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for airline offices, travel agencies and tour operators in Sri Lanka. Check booking advice, fee clarity, refunds and call centre service.
- [School and University Mystery Shopping in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/school-university-mystery-shopping-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for private schools, universities and training institutes in Sri Lanka. Check admissions enquiries, follow up and campus visit experience.
- [Government and Public Service Counter Audits in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/government-service-counter-audit-sri-lanka/): Independent service audits for public offices, utilities and state institutions in Sri Lanka. Check queue times, clarity of forms, courtesy and language service.
- [E-commerce and Delivery Audits in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/ecommerce-delivery-audit-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for online stores, delivery services and food delivery in Sri Lanka. Test ordering, delivery time, packaging, rider conduct and returns.
- [Vehicle Showroom and Service Centre Audits in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/vehicle-showroom-audit-sri-lanka/): Mystery shopping for car, motorcycle and equipment showrooms and service centres in Sri Lanka. Check sales advice, test drives, price clarity and workshop service.
- [Call Centre and Helpline Mystery Calls in Sri Lanka](https://verifylanka.com/call-centre-mystery-calls-sri-lanka/): Mystery calls for call centres, hotlines and helplines in Sri Lanka. Test pick up time, script use, accuracy, tone and first call resolution in all languages.

## Key facts

- Independent: auditors have no link to the businesses they audit.
- Report turnaround: within 48 hours of the visit.
- Languages checked: Sinhala, Tamil and English.
- Methods: mystery shopping, mystery calls, branch audits, compliance checks, monthly tracking programmes.
